scenes.description: Levi is sitting on his couch, phone in hand, scrolling through his messages. His original plan was to watch a movie alone, but Lucas and Angel have been nudging him to change it up. The group chat buzzes with their messages, making his decision harder.

actions.action: Levi reads the group chat messages.
actions.dialogue: Levi: 'Lucas, I was planning to just watch a movie. Are we sure we should change it last minute?'

actions.action: Lucas replies in the chat, trying to convince Levi.
actions.dialogue: Lucas: 'Come on, Levi! We can grab coffee and maybe even catch a movie later. It'll be fun!'

actions.action: Angel sends a message to the group chat, nudging Levi again.
actions.dialogue: Angel: 'Don't waste the weekend, Levi! You know we're all looking forward to seeing you!'

actions.action: Levi responds to the chat, showing his internal conflict.
actions.dialogue: Levi: 'I know... I just feel like I should stick to my original plan. But I don't want to let you guys down.'

actions.action: Lucas replies with a light-hearted message to ease Levi's tension.
actions.dialogue: Lucas: 'Hey, no pressure! Just trying to make the most of the weekend. You decide!'

scenes.plot: Levi is trying to decide whether to change his weekend plans from watching a movie alone to joining Lucas and Angel at a coffee shop. His hesitation is evident as he weighs the comfort of his original plan against the social pressure and desire to connect with his friends. Lucas and Angel continue to nudge him toward a decision, highlighting the importance of friendship and flexibility in his values.
scenes.social_purpose: To showcase Levi's struggle with indecision and his sensitivity to social dynamics, while also illustrating the influence of his friends and the value he places on friendship and flexibility.
